Factory reset warning.
A fresh backup will be created first. Then all database data, including users, memberships, messages, settings, and audit records, will be removed.

Final factory reset confirmation.
The database will return to a clean migrated state. Super admins will be recreated from SUPER_ADMIN_IDS after the bot restarts.
